title: Volunteer Event Checklist
subtitle: Capture service role, shift, site lead, and task boundary; confirm equipment and hours confirmation.
description: Volunteer Event records service role, shift, site lead, task boundary, equipment, and hours confirmation. Volunteer Event evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this volunteer event stage-gated verification when staff must document service role and shift. Reconcile site lead, task boundary, equipment, and hours confirmation before the volunteer event handoff. Use the role description, shift roster, site-lead brief, safety equipment issue, task completion sheet, break record, hours verification, and departure log. This record assigns a service contributor to a nonprofit or community shift with a task brief, site supervisor, tools, protective equipment, break coverage, verified hours, and service exit. Ask the assigned volunteer event reviewer to confirm service role against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Volunteer Event starting details
sections.guidance: Assign service role, shift, site lead, task boundary, tool or protective equipment, breaks, accessibility route, completed hours, and departure.

sections.title: Volunteer Event checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current volunteer event facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Volunteer Event required checks
items: Service role is identified for this record
Shift matches the current request or source
Site lead is ready for point-of-use staff
Task boundary limits or questions are resolved
Equipment is communicated to the responsible person
Hours confirmation is confirmed at handoff

blocks.label: Volunteer Event failed or pending items

sections.title: Volunteer Event decision and readiness
sections.guidance: Hold volunteer event readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Volunteer Event reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Volunteer Event receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
